//: Greeting looks (terminal.fastfetchPreset). Each <id>.jsonc is a plain fastfetch config; colour names in it follow the shell palette when the greeting is written (backend/pkg/termlook/fastfetch.go): magenta = primary, blue = secondary, cyan and yellow = tertiary, green = success, red = error, white = text, light_black = outline. `logo: false` presets ignore terminal.fastfetchLogo; `own` runs plain fastfetch with the user's own config.
